# Epic Global Inc.

> Epic Global Inc. is a wholesale trade partner and global marketplace operator. It buys brands' inventory upfront at wholesale and sells it on Amazon, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop and other marketplaces, paying for the advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment itself so incentives stay aligned. It is not an agency: no retainers, hourly rates or consulting packages.

## Key facts
- Model: Buy, Sell, Advertise, Protect. Epic buys inventory upfront at wholesale, sells it at retail, funds the advertising, and protects price and catalog (Brand Registry authorization, MAP enforcement, removing unauthorized sellers).
- What Epic does: purchases inventory at wholesale pricing; operates retail sales across approved marketplaces; covers operating expenses including advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment; gives brands a shared dashboard from day one, monthly SKU-level reports and quarterly business reviews.
- Global expansion: launches and scales brands on new marketplaces and in new regions, with localization and compliance.
- Marketplaces: Amazon, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop and select international marketplaces across North America, Europe and other growth regions.
- Who Epic serves: brands that want to scale on marketplaces without building an internal marketplace operations team. Best fit is typically brands that already have traction and need better execution, control and expansion capacity.
- Founder: Glen Jensen
- Get started: [Free marketplace assessment](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/campaigns/marketplace-assessment)

## What Epic does not do
- No retainers, hourly rates or project fees
- No a la carte services or consulting packages
- No advice without execution
- No revenue share without inventory ownership
